title: Spanish Frittata with Cheeses
subtitle: baked over a crisp tortilla base
description: A Spanish-style frittata with potato, zucchini and onion, baked over a tortilla that turns into a crisp base, with feta, Grana Padano, cheddar and cottage cheese.

ingredients.name: Mixed Fresh Herbs (Parsley, Dill, Coriander, Spring Onion)

steps.text: Heat a little olive oil in a heavy ovenproof pan (the same diameter as the tortilla) and fry the sliced onion and zucchini for about 5 minutes until golden. Transfer to a bowl. Add a little more oil to the pan and fry the very finely diced potato for about 8 minutes until partly cooked. Add it to the onion and zucchini bowl and mix. Do not wash the pan.
Preheat the oven to 180°C on the top grill setting.
Whisk the eggs, cheeses, herbs, chilli, salt and pepper in a bowl, then add the fried vegetables and mix.
Heat a little oil in the pan, lay in the tortilla, pour over the frittata mixture and cook over medium heat for about 2 minutes, until the edges just begin to set.
Transfer the pan to the oven and bake for 5 to 7 more minutes until nicely golden. Serve immediately.
